claims.description: The deterministic learner-visible safety response inventory covers suitability soft blocks, catastrophic tripwire responses, image-screening uncertainty, and dangerous-procedure refusal. Only the suitability and sexual-content-minor messages required changes; self-harm, abuse-disclosure, image-screening, and dangerous-procedure responses remain unchanged and covered by the expanded safety regression run.
The suitability soft block now resets neutrally and offers schoolwork, high-level explanation, and related-question paths. Its regression rejects intent-questioning and second-person blame language.
The sexual-content-minor tripwire now names the declined content narrowly, offers age-appropriate bodies, boundaries, consent, and staying-safe help, and retains a non-blaming trusted-adult route.

Judge route failure still returns the original tutor reply with unavailable=true, while the operator alarm remains a structured metadata-only Inngest event. Tests inject a raw provider/classifier error and prove it never enters the learner response or event payload.

No detector, threshold, allowlist, category, age gate, feature flag, routing decision, or fail-open control changed. The dangerous-procedure over-block and negative-path suite remains green alongside suitability and catastrophic-tripwire coverage.

Red-green evidence: the new suitability and sexual-content-minor assertions failed against the original messages, then passed after the two production copy changes. Focused final verification passed 169/169 tests; the full API unit surface passed 495/495 suites and 9,764 tests with 9 skipped.

No rephrase action, block-to-rephrase observability, false-positive instrumentation, prompt, schema, or UI work was added; WI-2115 remains the owner of those recovery-action and observability changes.
